mapper.select: SELECT update_offset, emergency_stop, stop_reason, stop_by, stop_at FROM growth_tg_state WHERE id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE growth_tg_state SET update_offset = #{offset}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = 1 AND update_offset < #{offset}
UPDATE growth_tg_state SET emergency_stop = #{stop}, stop_reason = #{reason}, stop_by = #{by}, stop_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = 1 AND emergency_stop <> #{stop}
mapper.sql: target_key, lang, chat_id, enabled, enabled_at, fail_streak, disabled_reason, last_alert_at, updated_by, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM growth_tg_target ORDER BY target_key DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE growth_tg_target SET chat_id = #{chatId}, updated_by = #{by}, updated_at = #{now}, enabled_at = CASE WHEN #{enabled} AND enabled = 0 THEN #{now} ELSE enabled_at END, enabled = #{enabled}, fail_streak = CASE WHEN #{enabled} THEN 0 ELSE fail_streak END, disabled_reason = CASE WHEN #{enabled} THEN NULL ELSE disabled_reason END WHERE target_key = #{key}
UPDATE growth_tg_target SET fail_streak = 0 WHERE target_key = #{key} AND fail_streak <> 0
UPDATE growth_tg_target SET last_alert_at = #{now} WHERE target_key = #{key} AND (last_alert_at IS NULL OR last_alert_at < #{before})
mapper.sql: chat_id, chat_type, title, status, broadcast, broadcast_at, lang, start_param, fail_streak, added_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO growth_tg_chat (chat_id, chat_type, title, status, broadcast, lang, start_param, fail_streak, added_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{chatId}, #{type}, #{title}, 'ACTIVE', 0, 'zh-CN', #{start}, 0, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), chat_type = VALUES(chat_type), status = 'ACTIVE', start_param = COALESCE(start_param, VALUES(start_param)), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE growth_tg_chat SET status = 'LEFT', broadcast = 0, updated_at = #{now} WHERE chat_id = #{chatId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE growth_tg_chat SET broadcast_at = CASE WHEN #{on} AND broadcast = 0 THEN #{now} ELSE broadcast_at END, broadcast = #{on}, lang = COALESCE(#{lang}, lang), fail_streak = 0, updated_at = #{now} WHERE chat_id = #{chatId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM growth_tg_chat ORDER BY status, broadcast DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM growth_tg_chat WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND broadcast = 1 ORDER BY chat_id
mapper.update: UPDATE growth_tg_chat SET broadcast = CASE WHEN fail_streak + 1 >= #{limit} THEN 0 ELSE broadcast END, fail_streak = fail_streak + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE chat_id = #{chatId}
UPDATE growth_tg_chat SET fail_streak = 0 WHERE chat_id = #{chatId} AND fail_streak <> 0
mapper.select: SELECT kind, lang, status, fingerprint, approved_by, approved_at, updated_at FROM growth_tg_template ORDER BY kind, lang DESC
SELECT kind, lang, status, fingerprint, approved_by, approved_at, updated_at FROM growth_tg_template WHERE kind = #{kind} AND lang = #{lang}
mapper.sql: id, market_no, kind, target, chat_id, lang, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, message_id, post_url, note, created_at, sent_at
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO growth_tg_post (market_no, kind, target, chat_id, lang, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, note, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{marketNo}, #{kind}, #{target}, #{chatId}, #{lang}, #{status}, 0, #{now}, #{note}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM growth_tg_post WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE growth_tg_post SET attempts = attempts + 1, next_attempt_at = #{until}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND attempts = #{attempts} AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}

UPDATE growth_tg_post SET status = 'SENT', message_id = #{messageId}, post_url = #{url}, note = NULL, sent_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND attempts = #{attempts}
UPDATE growth_tg_post SET attempts = attempts - 1, next_attempt_at = #{next}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND attempts = #{attempts}

UPDATE growth_tg_post SET status = #{status}, note = #{note}, next_attempt_at = COALESCE(#{next}, next_attempt_at), updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND attempts = #{attempts}
UPDATE growth_tg_post SET status = #{status}, note = #{note}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM growth_tg_post status = #{status} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
